title: Working with CloudFormation
description: Notes on organizing templates, naming resources, and keeping infrastructure changes manageable.
highlights: Use consistent names and template structure so resources are easy to find.
Catch template problems early with linting and local deployment checks.
Think through shared stacks, dependencies, and how values pass between them.

title: Keeping startup infrastructure simple
description: Why I try to keep early systems easy to change as their requirements develop.
highlights: Weigh the coordination cost before splitting an application into services.
Adopt Kubernetes when its benefits justify the operational work.
Use infrastructure modules to simplify a recurring task, rather than wrapping every individual resource.
